meta.description: Adjustable plinth leg for kitchen and wardrobe carcasses (Interior Cabinetry). Unified asset: plan, side elevation, 3D mesh and cabinet placement data. Units mm.
meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName. Geometry primitives in Paths arrays use PathType (Line | Arc | Circle | Polygon).

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks
fieldPrefixes.Na__CabinetPlacement__: Cabinet mounting data read by the Interior Cabinetry builders

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: UK kitchen cabinet leg: black plastic, screw adjustable, push-fit into the base panel, with the plinth clipped to the front legs. 150mm nominal.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Measured from the common UK 150mm adjustable leg (Howdens / Wren pattern). Origin = centre of the foot on the floor, Z up. The threaded column between 25 and 90 stretches or shrinks to the plinth height, so the foot, adjuster, sleeve and plate keep their true sizes.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__CabinetPlacement__Note: Placed at each leg point with its top plate touching the carcass underside.

Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of the leg. Seen from above.

Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of the foot on the floor. Seen from the side.

Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0,0 = centre of the foot on the floor; Z up to the top plate (150 nominal).
